BUCKET.description: The R2 bucket this CDN serves. Every path on the Worker streams an object out of it, and `POST /api/upload` is the only way in.

CDN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the file explorer at `/`. Object URLs stay public — this gates the browse/upload/delete UI only. It is a password field: let your password manager generate one.

CDN_UPLOAD_TOKEN.description: Not prompted for. Bearer token for `POST /api/upload`; unset means no machine write path at all. `cdn setup` generates and stores it.

CDN_SESSION_SECRET.description: Not prompted for. Signs the explorer's session cookie; unset derives the key from CDN_PASSWORD.

CDN_PURGE_TOKEN.description: Not prompted for. A Cloudflare API token scoped to Zone → Cache Purge; unset means the cache purge is local-POP only. `cdn setup` mints it.
